metadata.question: Did sea surface temperatures near the coast of La Jolla, California exceed 23 degrees Celcius on August 1, 2018?

data.raw_code: The question asks: "Did sea surface temperatures near the coast of La Jolla, California exceed 23 degrees Celsius on August 1, 2018?" We need to: 1. Find SST data for August 1, 2018 near La Jolla, California 2. Check if temperature exceeded 23°C Key considerations: - Location: La Jolla, California (coordinates approx: 32.847, -117.274) - Date: August 1, 2018 (single day) - Variable: Sea Surface Temperature (SST) Potential data sources: 1. MODIS Terra/Aqua SST - daily, good spatial resolution 2. NOAA OISST - daily, coarser resolution but reliable 3. VIIRS SST - newer but available from 2012 We'll try: 1. First try MODIS Terra SST (MOD28) - daily at 4.63km 2. If no data, try MODIS Aqua SST (MYD28) 3. If still no data, try NOAA OISST We need to: - Check if collection has data - Extract SST value at the location - Convert from Kelvin to Celsius if needed (MODIS uses Kelvin) - Compare to 23°C Quality checks: - MODIS SST has quality flags, we should use only good quality pixels - Check if pixel count > 0 after masking - Validate temperature range (reasonable SST: -2°C to 40°C) Potential issues: - La Jolla is coastal, might have mixed land/water pixels - Cloud cover could obscure SST measurement ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const laJolla = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.274, 32.847]); // La Jolla, CA coordinates const date = '2018-08-01'; const bufferDistance = 1000; // 1km buffer to ensure we get water pixels // Create a buffer around the point to get nearby ocean pixels const region = laJolla.buffer(bufferDistance); // 2. Data Acquisition - Try multiple SST datasets let sstImage = null; let datasetUsed = ''; // Function to get MODIS SST image with quality masking const getMODIS_SST = function(collectionId, date) { const col = ee.ImageCollection(collectionId) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(region); if (col.size().getInfo() === 0) return null; const img = col.first(); // MODIS SST is in Kelvin, convert to Celsius const sst = img.select('sst').multiply(0.01).subtract(273.15); // Scale factor 0.01 for MODIS // Use quality flag (0=bad, 3=best) const quality = img.select('qual_sst'); const mask = quality.gte(2); // Keep medium and high quality return sst.updateMask(mask); }; // Try MODIS Terra (MOD28) first sstImage = getMODIS_SST('MODIS/006/MOD28', date); if (sstImage) { datasetUsed = 'MODIS Terra (MOD28)'; } else { // Try MODIS Aqua (MYD28) sstImage = getMODIS_SST('MODIS/006/MYD28', date); if (sstImage) { datasetUsed = 'MODIS Aqua (MYD28)'; } else { // Try NOAA OISST as fallback const oisstCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(region); if (oisstCol.size().getInfo() > 0) { sstImage = oisstCol.first().select('sst'); datasetUsed = 'NOAA OISST'; } } } // Check if we found any data if (!sstImage) { console.log(`No SST data found for ${date}`); console.log('C1'); return; } console.log(`Dataset used: ${datasetUsed}`); // 3. Processing - Get SST value const stats = sstImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanSST = stats.get('sst_mean'); const pixelCount = stats.get('sst_count'); // Get values const meanVal = meanSST.getInfo(); const countVal = pixelCount.getInfo(); console.log(`Date: ${date}`); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${countVal}`); console.log(`Mean SST: ${meanVal !== null ? meanVal.toFixed(2) + '°C' : 'null'}`); // 4. Check for valid pixels if (countVal === 0 || meanVal === null) { console.log('No valid SST pixels after quality masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Validation & Final Answer // Check if value is within reasonable SST range (-2 to 40°C) if (meanVal < -2 || meanVal > 40 || !isFinite(meanVal)) { console.log(`Invalid SST value: ${meanVal}°C`); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if temperature exceeded 23°C if (meanVal > 23) { console.log(`SST (${meanVal.toFixed(2)}°C) exceeded 23°C`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`SST (${meanVal.toFixed(2)}°C) did not exceed 23°C`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
